import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 本命物分类处理器
 * 路由:
 *   /储物袋 本命 - 显示储物袋中的本命物实例（未炼化且未上架）
 *
 * 数据来源：
 *   Go 本命物背包投影 → 服务端已筛选未炼化、未上架实例并给出操作资格
 */

import { DEFAULT_PAGE, EMPTY_STRING, FIRST_ARG_INDEX, MIN_PAGE } from '@src/constants';
import App from '@src/response-apps/storage/newBag/soulArtifacts/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { formatSoulArtifactItem } from '@src/response/storage/newBag/soulArtifacts/formatter';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
/**
 * 解析命令参数
 */
const parseCommand = (msg: string): { page: number } => {
  const args = msg.replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?(我的)?(储物袋|背包)\s+本命\s*/, EMPTY_STRING).trim();

  if (!args) {
    return { page: DEFAULT_PAGE };
  }

  const parts = args.split(/\s+/);
  let page = DEFAULT_PAGE;

  if (parts[FIRST_ARG_INDEX] && !isNaN(Number(parts[FIRST_ARG_INDEX]))) {
    page = Math.max(MIN_PAGE, Number(parts[FIRST_ARG_INDEX]));
  }

  return { page };
};

const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  try {
    const uid = e.uid as number;
    const { page } = parseCommand(e.MessageText ?? EMPTY_STRING);

    const result = await App({ bid: e.UserId, uid, page });

    if (result.code !== 'OK') {
      throw new Error('查询本命物失败，请稍后重试');
    }

    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    if (result.data.total === 0) {
      md.addText('暂无本命物');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('可通过商店购买、里程碑奖励等途径获取');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '储物袋 · 本命', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    for (const item of result.data.items) {
      formatSoulArtifactItem(item, md);
      md.addNewline();
    }
    md.addNewline();

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '储物袋 · 本命',
        content: md,
        nav: {
          current: page,
          total: Math.ceil(result.data.total / result.data.pageSize),
          command: '/储物袋 本命 {page}'
        }
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('本命物分类处理失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('查询本命物失败，请稍后重试');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '储物袋 · 本命', content: md }));
  }
});

export default response;
